description_en: Rolls back a playbook to a specified version. You can also specify whether to publish the version during the rollback
description_zh: 用于回滚剧本到指定的版本，同时可以指定回滚时是否发布该版本
name: RevertPlaybookRelease

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.
You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the playbook release version.
You can call the [DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本发布版本的ID。
调用[DescribePlaybookReleases](~~DescribePlaybookReleases~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: play_release_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to publish the version directly after the rollback.
true (default): Publish and roll back.
false: Only roll back without publishing
parameters.help_zh:
回滚版本后，是否直接发布。
true（默认）：发布并回滚
false：不发布，只回滚
parameters.name: is_publish

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
